claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: The report shows engines and transmissions outdoors but not the seller's wider inventory or business.

risks.risk: The engine may be seized or otherwise non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of the engine cranking or running, or a compression test result.

risks.risk: Mileage or hours of use are unknown.
risks.proof: A photo of the donor vehicle's odometer or recorded engine hours.

risks.risk: Service history or repairs are undocumented.
risks.proof: Service records or repair receipts for the engine.

risks.risk: Accessories such as alternator or starter may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing all accessories mounted on the engine.
risks.if_unproven: as a bare engine without accessories

risks.risk: Compatibility with specific vehicle makes or models is unknown.
risks.proof: A photo of the donor vehicle VIN or plate, or fitment documentation.

risks.risk: Engine brand and model cannot be read from the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up of the engine identification plate or block casting numbers.

risks.risk: No warranty or return policy is offered.
risks.proof: A screenshot or written copy of warranty and return terms.
risks.if_unproven: as sold as-is with no warranty

proof_requests: Video of the engine cranking or running
Close-up of the engine identification plate or block casting numbers
Photo showing all accessories mounted on the engine
Photo of the donor vehicle odometer or VIN/plate
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a used car engine, so it can be priced at its worst case; proof of running condition, accessories, brand, and fitment would raise the value.
